# 00000002787

**AG3-17 ★** — source: 78_渐近几何_Banach局部理论II.md

**English.** Definition: Gowers random blocks: the structure of randomized block sequences. Conjecture: The convergence law of random blocks: the asymptotic type of the block space generated by a random field is almost surely a fixed type — the stable-type extremum of the initial space. (Gowers random block convergence)

**中文。** 定义：Gowers 随机块：随机化的块序列的结构。猜想：随机块的收敛律：随机场生成的块空间的渐近型以概率一为固定型且型为初始空间的稳定型极值。（Gowers 随机块收敛）
